studies.title: TrainLoop AI
studies.what_mattered: Failed-attempt accounting, slice metrics, trace review, candidate selection, batch-first post-training, policy lag, and LoRA update geometry make autoresearch inspectable instead of hiding the search process behind a final score.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM added a technique registry, SQL candidate-selection tooling, slice metrics, trace review, a batch plan renderer, and LoRA geometry documentation and tooling.
studies.boundary: The distributed autoresearch operating pattern was not copied. Only methods that remain useful and auditable on one Mac were retained.
studies.next_action: Retain the methods as evidence. Any new candidate-selection run requires a fresh scoped experiment with a frozen evaluator.

studies.title: TrainLoop NollaMD case study
studies.what_mattered: Candidate-selection framing can make a sparse task measurable when unconstrained generation is too difficult or too ambiguous to grade reliably.
studies.local_translation: The SQL lane gained a candidate-selection step before open SQL generation so selection quality can be separated from generation quality.
studies.boundary: The framing is a method, not evidence that the PostTrainLLM SQL specialist is competitive. No fresh candidate model result is implied.
studies.next_action: A future run would need a frozen candidate set, held-out execution gate, and explicit comparison with open generation.

studies.title: TrainLoop OAPL writeup
studies.what_mattered: Batch rollouts, offline scoring, and compact updates can make a post-training loop easier to inspect, while policy lag can stabilize learning under some reward surfaces.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM retained a batch post-training plan but did not schedule an OAPL-style run before a clean reward surface exists.
studies.boundary: Policy lag is not assumed to help every target. It remains a hypothesis until a bounded local comparison isolates it.
studies.next_action: Use only after candidate selection and reward validity have independent evidence.

studies.title: TrainLoop LoRA geometry writeup
studies.what_mattered: Effective update geometry, layer placement, and controlled rank analysis can explain why two adapters with similar parameter counts behave differently.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM added LoRA geometry diagnostics and retained a controlled rank-and-layer sweep as a possible future experiment.
studies.boundary: Geometry diagnostics describe an update; they do not establish task improvement without the same frozen behavioral evaluation used for the baseline.
studies.next_action: Attach lora-geometry.json to the next authorized adapter run and compare it beside task and regression scores.

studies.title: TrainLoop Mercor coding-agent post
studies.what_mattered: File-native and code-native harnesses may fit knowledge-work agents better than bespoke tool APIs because the environment already exposes durable state and familiar operations.
studies.local_translation: Future coding-agent work should prefer file and code surfaces when they are the natural task boundary.
studies.boundary: The coding-agent product lane is not active, and this study does not authorize a new agent runtime or evaluation campaign.
studies.next_action: Revisit only if the owner opens a concrete coding-agent target.

studies.title: Baseten post-training positioning
studies.what_mattered: Post-training is a system of custom data, reward shaping, performance work, infrastructure, evaluation, and packaging rather than a generic fine-tuning screen.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM was reframed as a Mac-local specialist factory organized around target, data, post-training, evaluation, packaging, and reporting.
studies.boundary: The positioning was adopted, not Baseten's hosted infrastructure or scale assumptions.
studies.next_action: Keep factory documentation centered on the complete evidence loop and one-Mac constraints.

studies.title: Hugging Face model hub and SQL specialists
studies.what_mattered: Small public SQL models provide realistic baselines and expose how much benchmark, model size, and serving format affect apparently similar claims.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM compared cssupport/t5-small-awesome-text-to-sql and reviewed prem-1B-SQL, Qwen SQL variants, and SQLCoder-class models.
studies.boundary: Model-card scores from different datasets are directional context, not a head-to-head result against the local specialist.
studies.next_action: Require a shared public execution benchmark before making a serious SQL competitiveness claim.

studies.title: Defog SQLCoder and Arctic Text2SQL class models
studies.what_mattered: Strong SQL systems report execution accuracy on substantial SQL benchmarks rather than relying on exact string match alone.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM treats Spider or BIRD-style execution as a required public gate before elevating a SQL result beyond a local fixture.
studies.boundary: External category scores remain non-comparable until the same dataset, schema context, prompting, and execution rules are used.
studies.next_action: Build and run a bounded Spider or BIRD Mini execution gate only under a fresh authorized experiment.

studies.title: Apple on-device Foundation Models
studies.what_mattered: Apple's system model is a free and private routing floor, but its context and action-grounding limits make it unsuitable as the core capability dependency for a realistic tool catalog.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM measured the framework, retained a bridge for comparison, ruled out adapter dependency, and kept owned weights plus owned evaluation as the differentiation.
studies.boundary: Core ML remains a possible deployment target for owned weights. The rejection applies to depending on Apple's closed model for capability, not to every Apple runtime technology.
studies.next_action: Use the system model only where a fresh task-specific gate proves it sufficient.

studies.title: Castform RL fine-tune platform
studies.what_mattered: Composite rewards, trace-driven data loops, reasoning-depth classification, and explicit environment contracts make reinforcement-style fine-tuning more inspectable.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM mapped those ideas into composite reward scaffolding, trace-to-data workflows, and reasoning-depth classification.
studies.boundary: The hosted dashboard and pay-per-compute product model were not copied, and the scaffolding is not proof that an RLVR run improves a specialist.
studies.next_action: Connect rewards to an authorized training loop only after the evaluator and held-out gate are frozen.

studies.title: Cline and agent context hierarchy research
studies.what_mattered: Structured-output enforcement and an explicit context hierarchy can reduce ambiguous agent actions and make tool boundaries easier to inspect.
studies.local_translation: PostTrainLLM retained the tool protocol shape and context hierarchy as learning assets for a future coding-agent lane.
studies.boundary: The research did not justify another agent layer or a coding product. Tool quality and a frozen task gate still come first.
studies.next_action: Revisit only when a concrete coding-agent target and evaluation exist.

studies.title: Gigatoken
studies.what_mattered: SIMD and cache-heavy bulk BPE can make first-pass tokenization much faster on large corpora, including Qwen tokenizers on Apple Silicon.
studies.local_translation: The implementation is retained as an optional offline data-preparation accelerator rather than a default tokenizer dependency.
studies.boundary: No current bottleneck was solved. Adoption requires exact token-ID parity and bounded peak memory on the real tokenizer and corpus.
studies.next_action: Revisit only for multi-gigabyte corpora or measured tokenization above ten percent of run time.

studies.title: Needle 2
studies.what_mattered: A compact call-only model combines top-five tool retrieval, constrained decoding, confidence escalation, bounded context, quantization, and a small packaged Mac artifact.
studies.local_translation: A 94-case local smoke reached 34.0 percent exact tool selection. Oracle catalog restriction reached 38.3 percent overall but regressed Pace and retained false actions.
studies.boundary: Catalog restriction is a latency lever, not a capability rescue. Package size and narrow call formatting do not establish grounded tool competence.
studies.next_action: Stop before integration or fine-tuning unless a new model or method changes the capability premise.

studies.title: parakeet.wgsl
studies.what_mattered: Raw WebGPU plus SIMD-WASM can run Parakeet TDT browser inference with public kernels, a package format, cache behavior, a converter, and a benchmark harness.
studies.local_translation: The pinned package transcribed a 17 minute 10 second public fixture in 7.2 to 7.8 seconds on Apple WebGPU. Warm output was deterministic and no external request was observed.
studies.boundary: This validates reproducible browser execution, not transcription accuracy against a shared reference or readiness for default product integration. The 386.5 MiB package remains material.
studies.next_action: Run a small shared reference-transcribed comparison against WhisperKit before considering integration.

studies.title: Savante and Aryabhata
studies.what_mattered: Curated domain data, filtered reasoning traces, supervised fine-tuning, model merging, and verifiable-reward reinforcement learning combine in a JEE mathematics specialist.
studies.local_translation: The study teaches how to separate initialization, data, filtering, training stages, reward, and evaluation before adapting a recipe to a Mac-sized target.
studies.boundary: The published result does not isolate each stage's contribution, and H100 training is not evidence of Mac-local reproducibility.
studies.next_action: Write a recipe teardown and freeze an independent test; running it would require a new scoped experiment and resource budget.

studies.title: Bonsai 2 27B
studies.what_mattered: Ternary representation, packing overhead, activation transforms, kernel support, artifact size, runtime memory, and capability retention can rank a model differently depending on the deployment constraint.
studies.local_translation: The retained exercise is a same-Mac comparison sheet covering revisions, task gates, peak RAM, time to first token, prefill, decode throughput, and total task latency.
studies.boundary: File size is not peak runtime memory, and retention relative to a source model does not establish frontier parity.
studies.next_action: A future comparison requires owner selection, bounded resources, and exact runtime and weight revisions.

studies.title: QORL
studies.what_mattered: Parameter-aware query optimization needs equal search budgets, fresh held-out measurement, SQL-equivalence checks, and a native-planner baseline before an offline plan search can claim value.
studies.local_translation: The owner-proposed local experiment isolates offline search and a parameter-to-plan dispatcher while keeping language-model training outside the scope.
studies.boundary: Selection bias, cache state, parameter skew, routing overhead, and tuning cost can erase an apparent speedup.
studies.next_action: Freeze parameter splits, workload weights, cache policy, timeouts, fallback behavior, and break-even accounting before any run.

studies.title: Inside vLLM
studies.what_mattered: Admission control, scheduling, paged KV allocation, prefill, decode, continuous batching, caching, and distributed execution explain why a serving engine behaves differently from a single-request model loop.
studies.local_translation: The study maps the boundary between one-device Mac inference and cluster serving through a hand-simulated request and KV-block budget.
studies.boundary: The goal is boundary mapping, not reproducing a multi-GPU serving system on one Mac or claiming equivalent throughput.
studies.next_action: Simulate requests under fixed token and KV budgets, then explain effects on latency, throughput, and memory.

studies.title: Splash model-specific Mac inference
studies.what_mattered: Shape-specific Metal kernels, a model-specific speculative draft, packed weights, cache reuse, and a startup memory plan trade generic model support for Mac-local serving performance.
studies.local_translation: The retained exercise compares a specialized engine with a general engine on cold and cached latency, prefill, decode, concurrency, memory, output validity, and task completion.
studies.boundary: A model-specific runtime can be fast without being a general serving replacement, and tuning cost must be included beside runtime gains.
studies.next_action: Design the same-Mac comparison before considering implementation or model-specific kernel work.
